theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 3 群

items.colloc: active member 會員 | take an active part in 積極參與
items.distinct: proactive 主動的 | energetic 精力充沛的
ex: She remains active in the local business community.
她在當地商業圈依然活躍。
The company is looking for an active participant.
公司正在尋找積極的參與者。
We need an active strategy to boost sales.
我們需要一個積極的策略來提升銷售。

items.colloc: friendly atmosphere 友好的氣氛 | create an atmosphere 營造氛圍
items.distinct: environment 環境 | mood 情緒
ex: The office has a professional and calm atmosphere.
辦公室有一種專業且冷靜的氣氛。
We aim to create a welcoming atmosphere for guests.
我們致力於為賓客營造熱情的氛圍。
The meeting atmosphere turned tense during the discussion.
討論期間會議的氣氛變得緊張。

items.colloc: convert into 轉換成 | convert currency 兌換貨幣
items.distinct: transform 外型轉變 | change 改變
ex: You can convert the document into a PDF file.
你可以將這份文件轉換成 PDF 檔。
The currency was converted at the current rate.
貨幣已按現行匯率進行兌換。
We plan to convert the old warehouse into offices.
我們計畫將舊倉庫改建成辦公室。

items.colloc: currently available 現有可用的 | currently under construction 施工中
items.distinct: presently 不久後；目前 | recently 最近
ex: The manager is currently attending a regional meeting.
經理目前正在參加區域會議。
Our product is currently out of stock online.
我們的產品目前在網路上缺貨。
We are currently reviewing the annual budget proposal.
我們目前正在審核年度預算提案。

items.colloc: especially important 特別重要 | especially for 專門為了
items.distinct: specially 專門地 | particularly 特別地
ex: This software is especially useful for small teams.
這款軟體對小型團隊特別有用。
We appreciate your support, especially during the crisis.
我們感謝您的支持，尤其是在危機期間。
The event was organized especially for our clients.
這次活動是專門為我們的客戶舉辦的。

items.pos: n. 經驗 | v. 經歷；體驗
items.colloc: work experience 工作經驗 | gain experience 獲得經驗
items.distinct: experiment 實驗 | expertise 專業技能
ex: The candidate has five years of marketing experience.
這位應徵者有五年行銷經驗。
Customers can experience our latest models today.
顧客今天可以體驗我們的最新型號。
We experienced some technical issues during the demo.
我們在演示過程中經歷了一些技術問題。

items.colloc: give feedback 給予回饋 | give a presentation 做簡報
items.distinct: offer 提供；提議 | provide 提供
ex: Please give me your feedback on the report.
請給我您對報告的回饋。
The CEO will give a speech at the ceremony.
執行長將在典禮上致詞。
Can you give us a discount on this order?
您能給我們這筆訂單一些折扣嗎？

items.colloc: long-term investment 長期投資 | make an investment 進行投資
items.distinct: asset 資產 | interest 利息
ex: The company made a major investment in technology.
公司在科技方面進行了一筆重大投資。
This project is a safe investment for our firm.
這個專案對我們公司來說是一項安全的投資。
We are analyzing the returns on our investment.
我們正在分析我們的投資報酬。

items.colloc: related to 與...相關 | related fields 相關領域
items.distinct: relative 相對的 | relevant 有關的
ex: Does this issue relate to the new policy?
這個問題跟新政策有關嗎？
We discussed topics related to international trade.
我們討論了與國際貿易相關的話題。
Please provide all documents related to the claim.
請提供所有與索賠相關的文件。

items.colloc: remain silent 保持沉默 | remain open 保持開放
items.distinct: maintain 維持 | stay 停留
ex: The office will remain closed during the holiday.
辦公室在假期期間將保持關閉。
We must remain focused on our primary goals.
我們必須保持專注於主要目標。
The exact cause of the problem remains unknown.
問題的確切原因仍然未知。

items.pos: n. 休息；剩餘部分 | v. 休息
items.colloc: the rest of 其餘的 | take a rest 休息一下
items.distinct: remainder 剩餘物 | break 暫停；休息時間
ex: You should take a rest after the long meeting.
長會議後你應該休息一下。
I will finish the rest of the work tomorrow.
我明天會完成剩餘的工作。
The rest of the team is working from home.
團隊的其他成員正在居家辦公。

items.colloc: accidentally deleted 意外刪除 | accidentally discovered 意外發現
items.distinct: incidentally 順便一提 | purposefully 刻意地
ex: I accidentally sent the email to the wrong address.
我不小心把電子郵件寄錯地址了。
The file was accidentally deleted by the system.
檔案被系統意外刪除了。
He accidentally found the answer in the manual.
他在手冊中意外找到了答案。

items.pos: n. 帳戶；說明 | v. 解釋
items.colloc: bank account 銀行帳戶 | account for 解釋；佔比
items.distinct: amount 總額 | invoice 發票
ex: Please update your contact details in the account.
請更新您帳戶內的聯絡資訊。
We need to account for all the expenses.
我們需要說明所有的費用開支。
Sales in Asia account for half of our revenue.
亞洲的銷售額佔了我們營收的一半。

items.colloc: adjust the settings 調整設定 | adjust to new conditions 適應新環境
items.distinct: adapt 適應；改編 | modify 修改
ex: We need to adjust the schedule for next week.
我們需要調整下週的行程表。
It took time to adjust to the new software.
花了一些時間才適應這套新軟體。
Please adjust your chair to a comfortable height.
請將您的椅子調整到舒適的高度。

items.colloc: place an advertisement 刊登廣告 | online advertisement 線上廣告
items.distinct: advertising 廣告活動（總稱）| commercial 電視廣播廣告
ex: The advertisement will be published in the journal.
這則廣告將刊登在期刊上。
We designed a new advertisement for the product launch.
我們為產品發布設計了一則新廣告。
Did you see our latest advertisement on social media?
你有在社群媒體上看到我們的最新廣告嗎？

items.colloc: agree with 與...同意 | reach an agreement 達成協議
items.distinct: accept 接受 | approve 批准
ex: Both parties agreed to the terms of the contract.
雙方都同意合約條款。
I agree that we need to hire more staff.
我同意我們需要招募更多員工。
They could not agree on a starting date.
他們無法就開始日期達成共識。

items.colloc: alternatively, you can... 你也可以...
items.distinct: optionally 隨意地 | specifically 特別地
ex: You can pay by cash. Alternatively, use a credit card.
你可以付現金。或者，使用信用卡。
We could drive there, or alternatively, take a train.
我們可以開車去，或者改搭火車。
Alternatively, we can hold the meeting via Zoom.
或者，我們可以透過 Zoom 開會。

items.colloc: data analysis 數據分析 | conduct an analysis 進行分析
items.distinct: analyze 分析（動詞）| synthesis 綜合
ex: The analysis shows a steady growth in sales.
分析顯示銷售額穩步增長。
We need a detailed analysis of the market trends.
我們需要對市場趨勢進行詳細分析。
Her analysis of the report was very insightful.
她對這份報告的分析非常有見地。

items.colloc: deeply appreciate 非常感激 | appreciate your help 感謝你的協助
items.distinct: thank 謝謝 | value 重視
ex: We appreciate your continued support of our brand.
我們感謝您對我們品牌的持續支持。
I would appreciate it if you could finish early.
如果您能提早完成，我將不勝感激。
The team appreciates the feedback from the manager.
團隊很欣賞經理提供的回饋。

items.colloc: local authority 當地政府 | in authority 有權勢的
items.distinct: author 作者 | authorized 授權的
ex: She is a leading authority on financial law.
她是金融法律領域的頂尖權威。
You need permission from the local authority.
你需要獲得當地主管機關的許可。
The manager has the authority to sign the contract.
經理有權限簽署這份合約。
